active.rationale: This attribute controls the operational state of the rule and has no direct security impact.

auto_labeling_rule_id.description:
A unique ID for the new AutoLabelingRule. This ID will become the final
component of the AutoLabelingRule's resource name. If no ID is specified,
a server-generated ID will be used.

This value should be 4-64 characters and must match the regular
expression '^[A-Za-z0-9]{4,64}$'.
auto_labeling_rule_id.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

display_name.description: Display Name of the auto labeling rule.
display_name.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

label_key.rationale: The label key is a free-form identifier naming the label applied by the auto-labeling rule. Constraining what a team names its labels is not a security control and matches no policy archetype.

label_key_type.description: The type of the label key. Possible values: ["LABEL_KEY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "LABEL_KEY_TYPE_CUSTOM"]
label_key_type.rationale: Selects the category/type of the label key used by the auto-labeling rule. This is a labeling-configuration choice with no security consequence; enforcing a particular type matches no archetype.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

conditions.description: Conditions to apply for auto-labeling the label_key.

conditions.condition.description:
A optional CEL expression to be evaluated as a boolean value.
Once evaluated as true, then we will proceed with the value evaluation.
An empty condition will be auto evaluated as true.
conditions.condition.rationale: Defines CEL evaluation logic for auto-labeling. No direct security impact.

conditions.value.description: CEL expression to be evaluated as the value.
conditions.value.rationale: Defines the evaluated labeling value only. No direct security impact.
